parameters.content:
## Secrets Exposure & Credential Leak Monitor

### Quick Overview
Monitor a GitHub repository for possible credential exposure. Track unique findings in Notion and send one redacted email digest per batch.

### How It Works
Manual or scheduled runs scan bounded snapshots and available commit patches. New commits take priority while persistent cursors resume unfinished work. Checkpoints advance after incident and delivery receipts are saved.

### Setup
1. Set the repository, branch, sender and recipient in **Config: Target Repository**.
2. Connect GitHub credentials with repository contents read access, a Notion integration and SMTP.
3. Match the Notion properties: Name, Finding Hash, Repository, File Path, Masked Secret, Author, Severity, Status, Commit URL and Secret Fingerprint. Status options: **Open**, **Needs Review**, **Test**.
4. Run with `test_fixture=true`; check Notion and email, then restore `false`. Enable the schedule after reviewing the result.

### Customization
Adjust API, file and commit budgets, file-size limits and confidence thresholds. Tune provider patterns and generated-file exclusions for your repository.

### Additional Info
Requires native n8n Data Tables. Configured text files and available GitHub patches are not a complete Git audit. Findings require confirmation; an interrupted SMTP receipt can cause a repeated digest.

### Contact
Workflow setup and customization: [paoloronco.it](https://paoloronco.it).

## 01 - Start & Configure
Choose a manual run or schedule, then set the repository and notification addresses.

## 02 - Load Repository State
Create or reuse durable storage, validate its schema, and initialize missing repository state.

## 03 - Prevent Overlapping Scans
Acquire the repository lease before scanning. Concurrent runs stop when the lease is already held.

## 04 - Scan & Detect
Prioritize new commits, resume bounded snapshot/history work, and emit redacted findings.

## 06 - Deduplicate & Track Incidents
Look up finding fingerprints, create missing Notion records, and persist each incident receipt.

## 07 - Review & Notify
Send one redacted digest; keep lower-confidence candidates in Notion for review.

## 08 - Confirm Progress
Save delivery receipts, commit acknowledged cursors, release the lease, and report remaining work.
